class.name: IfcColourRgb
class.brief_description: Definition from ISO/CD 10303-46:1992 : A colour rgb as a subtype of colour specifications is defined by three colour component values for red, green, and blue in the RGB colour model. NOTE In contrary to the usual value range of colour components being integer from 0...255, the definition from ISO10303-46 defines the colour components as real from 0.0 ... 1.0. members.member: The intensity of the red colour component. NOTE The colour component value is given within the range of 0..1, and not within the range of 0..255 as otherwise usual.
The intensity of the green colour component. NOTE The colour component value is given within the range of 0..1, and not within the range of 0..255 as otherwise usual.
The intensity of the blue colour component. NOTE The colour component value is given within the range of 0..1, and not within the range of 0..255 as otherwise usual.
